description: Required test suites for exact-head worker validation. Every suite marked required must EXECUTE and PASS on the exact worker head. Missing tooling or a suite that never produced a result is NOT_CONFIGURED (block). Any skipped required test is SKIPPED_BLOCKER (block). A non-zero run is EXECUTED_FAIL (block). Only EXECUTED_PASS satisfies a required suite. Lane-specific suites are appended to the default set for the matching worker lane.
